outline:
本課程以國際時事為主軸，培養學生於英語口語互動中之理解、回應、分析與論述能力。藉由課堂討論、小組對話、議題回應、立場表述及簡短口頭報告等活動，學生將學習從多元角度理解國際事件，整理資訊、辨識觀點，並以清楚且具邏輯的英語參與討論。課程亦著重培養批判思考與國際視野，以提升學生在全球議題脈絡中之英語溝通能力。
This course centers on international current affairs and aims to develop students’ ability to comprehend, respond to, analyze, and articulate ideas in spoken English interaction. Through class discussion, small-group dialogue, issue-based responses, position statements, and short oral presentations, students will learn to approach international events from multiple perspectives, organize information, identify viewpoints, and participate in discussion in clear and logical English. The course also emphasizes the development of critical thinking and global awareness in order to strengthen students’ English communication skills in the context of global issues.

Learning objectives
By the end of the semester, students will be able to:
1.	Explain an international story clearly. Give a brief English account of what happened and why it matters, using relevant evidence.
2.	Judge how a story is supported and framed. Check a source beyond its own website, compare two accounts, and explain what remains uncertain.
3.	Sustain a discussion in English, including asking questions, responding to a classmate’s idea, and explaining a position with evidence.

Students will be strongly discouraged from using generative AI as a shortcut for language production, critical thinking, and independent projects. AI should never become a substitute for your own voice or judgment. This course is a place to practice discovering ideas and making choices for yourself, which matters more than quickly generating smooth (and ultimately lifeless) English.
